subject: Critical-path hold & ownership swap — updated MAP and gating asks
messages:
From: Sophie Liu <sophie@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pause on cutover — need to hold critical-path items

Naomi —

Quick update from my side: procurement has asked us to pause the next cutover (week of 8/17). Their team identified two gating items they want clarified in the MAP and the security questionnaire before they sign off: a) data retention terms for KV cache and b) audit log retention window.

I know the original MAP had those as follow-ups; procurement wants explicit commitments with owners and dates. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) commit to 90-day audit log retention for the sandbox environment used during eval, and 2) provide SOC2 evidence (or an SOC2 roadmap and interim controls) by 8/19?

If we can't get those, they will hold the procurement signature and we need to push the close. Sophie (ops) and I will need a clear owner on your side who will own the follow-ups — otherwise procurement will escalate to our legal team and that will add another 2–3 weeks.

Thanks,
Sophie Liu
Director, Cloud Ops — Acme

---
Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72 KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Liu <sophie@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pause on cutover — need to hold critical-path items

Sophie — thanks for flagging and for the clear asks. We own this and can move fast. Short answers:

- Audit logs: we can commit to 90-day retention for logs generated during the evaluation sandbox. We will formalize this in the MAP (deliverable: MAP_v2, tab "Logs/Retention"). Owner: Naomi Feldman (Redwood). Target date: 2026-08-18.
- SOC2 evidence: we cannot provide a final SOC2 cert by 8/19 (we are on a roadmap cadence), but we can provide the following by 8/19: a current SOC2 readiness summary, completed control matrix for ingest and storage (attached: SOC2-Checklist.pdf), and an intake from our security team with interim compensating controls for sandboxed evals. Owner for evidence: Rishi Malhotra (Security). Target date: 2026-08-19.

Proposal: to avoid delaying procurement, we propose a short-term mitigation: sign-off for the eval cutover conditioned on the documented 90-day retention and the SOC2 readiness packet delivered by 8/19. If procurement still needs legal-level acceptance, we can open a 48-hour executive bridge call.

I'll attach an updated MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) with explicit owners and dates in the first tab. cc'ing Rishi and Laura to confirm they can hit the dates.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference

3) If procurement requests an interim bridge, I will be available for a call on 8/19 between 09:00–12:00 PT.

Naomi / Rishi / Laura —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and for updating the MAP. Procurement reviewed the MAP_v2 and the SOC2 checklist and will accept the conditional sign-off for the evaluation cutover on the following basis:

- Redwood confirms 90-day audit log retention for the evaluation sandbox (noted in MAP_v2, tab "Logs/Retention").
- Redwood delivers the SOC2 readiness summary and control matrix by 8/19 (we received the packet and it satisfied procurement's immediate questions).
- Signed addendum will reference the evaluation-only acceptance and a mutual commitment to finalize production data handling before production go-live.

Procurement has signed the eval acceptance and expects the production contract signature no later than 2026-09-10. If Redwood needs any formal legal language changes, please route them to procurement@acme.com and cc Sophie.

We will proceed with cutover on 2026-08-24 per the MAP timelines. Appreciate the quick ownership swap — Sophie (ops) will track the open items in their internal tracker.

Sophie Liu
Director, Cloud Ops — Acme
